result.summary: The page is generally usable, but a few clipped/truncated carousel items and inconsistent favorite-button styling make parts look unfinished.

issues.description: In the “Fastest near you” carousel, the rightmost restaurant card is cut off at the screen edge and the name appears as “Trattoria Piccol...” without a clear ellipsis treatment.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent peek padding and ensure long restaurant names ellipsize cleanly within the card rather than being clipped by the viewport.

issues.description: The category chip row is partially cut off on the right edge, which can look like broken overflow even if it is intended to scroll.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade, more visible scroll affordance, or slightly reduce chip width/padding so the scrollable behavior is obvious.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons are visually inconsistent: the ramen card uses a plain outlined heart while the lower pizza card uses a filled dark circular backdrop.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite-button style across cards, with consistent contrast and placement.
